messages:
Maya S. (BetaMart): Hi team, after the 02:10 deploy last night our /v1/rerank results for a handful of canned queries changed order. We pin the reranker so we expected no behavioral change. This is blocking our merch sorting.

Lina C. (Customer Success): sorry to hear that — can you paste one minimal request + the two responses (before vs after)? Also which model id do you see in your logs?

Maya S. (BetaMart): model shows rw-rerank-2.10. We were pinned to rw-rerank-2.9. Example payload (redacted org ids):

Maya S. (BetaMart): ```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "model": "rw-rerank-2.10",
  "query": "wireless earbuds for running - sweatproof",
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c1", "text": "TrackRunner X - IPX7, 12hr battery"},
    {"id": "c2", "text": "SprintPods - snug fit, noise isolation"},
    {"id": "c3", "text": "BudgetBeat - cheap, decent sound"}
  ],
  "top_k": 3
}
```

Maya S. (BetaMart): -- recorded results pre-upgrade (rw-rerank-2.9):

Maya S. (BetaMart): ```
[ {"id":"c2","score":0.874}, {"id":"c1","score":0.861}, {"id":"c3","score":0.322} ]
```

Maya S. (BetaMart): -- after (rw-rerank-2.10):

Maya S. (BetaMart): ```
[ {"id":"c1","score":0.880}, {"id":"c2","score":0.859}, {"id":"c3","score":0.321} ]
```

Maya S. (BetaMart): ordering flipped for multiple curated queries. Not small float noise — top-1 swapped and score deltas ~0.02-0.03. Also saw one 502 on one replay.

Ravi P. (ML Eng): thanks, @Maya. A couple quick asks: 1) do you have hashes of cached candidate embeddings (to rule out upstream change)? 2) can you share the exact request timestamp for one failing call so we can correlate with deploy logs?

Maya S. (BetaMart): we hashed caches — candidate embeddings identical to our tests from before the upgrade. request ts: 2026-05-22T02:12:07Z (org=betamart).

deploy-bot: deploy rw-rerank-2.10 -> completed 2026-05-22T02:10:12Z (canary c-9274)

Noah K. (Runtime): pulling serving logs for canary c-9274 and org=betamart. Noting a single 502 spike at 02:12:06Z for a short window due to transient backend restart. Also seeing their requests routed to nodes tagged "new-quant" during canary.

Ravi P. (ML Eng): our model diff between 2.9 and 2.10 shows an intentional change: we added per-candidate L2 normalization prior to the dot-product aggregation to reduce bias for long texts. That can change absolute scores and ordering. Did we call that out in the release notes?

Eve R. (Product): I don't see a behavioral note — release notes mentioned perf and calibration only. That's on us. If it's an algorithmic change we should have marked it backward-incompatible.

Lina C. (Customer Success): BetaMart says they rely on deterministic ranking for their A/B stable UI. They want immediate rollback or a way to force legacy behavior.

Ravi P. (ML Eng): quick repro harness from my environment (sanitized):

Ravi P. (ML Eng): ```
# v2.9 (no per-candidate norm)
c2: 0.874125
c1: 0.861004
c3: 0.322811

# v2.10 (with per-candidate L2 norm)
c1: 0.880013
c2: 0.859217
c3: 0.321930
```

Ravi P. (ML Eng): note: when I run v2.10 but disable the per-candidate norm flag in our local runtime, scores revert to v2.9 ordering. So root cause is the normalization logic.

Noah K. (Runtime): for mitigations we have two immediate levers: 1) route betamart back to rw-rerank-2.9 pool (we can pin per-org routing) OR 2) add a runtime toggle to disable per-candidate norm for rw-rerank-2.10 for their org. Option 2 is faster (no weight rollback) but needs a short config change. Which does BetaMart prefer?

Maya S. (BetaMart): rollback to 2.9 ASAP please. We can't risk unexpected sorts in production. We also want a written explanation.

Eve R. (Product): agreed — do a targeted rollback/pin for betamart and draft a changelog/impact note. We should also add a compatibility flag to rerank API to request "legacy_scoring=true" for customers who need exact stability.

Noah K. (Runtime): rolling routing update now -> setting routing for org:betamart -> model:rw-rerank-2.9 (pool:fp16-stable). Will monitor and confirm.

Noah K. (Runtime): routing update complete. Logs show subsequent requests for org:betamart hitting 2.9 fp16 nodes; sampled scores from their replay match pre-upgrade recordings.

beta-bot: betamart-ticket-3211 status -> pinned to rw-rerank-2.9; customer notified.

Maya S. (BetaMart): confirmed via our canary tests — ordering restored. Thanks for the quick turn. Please share the postmortem and mitigation timeline.

Lina C. (Customer Success): ACTIONS: Noah to keep betamart pinned until customer opt-in; Ravi to produce a 100-query diff showing affected flips and examples by EOD; Eve to own changelog/update and compat flag roadmap; Lina to send the customer comms we agreed.

Ravi P. (ML Eng): initial diff summary (sanitized): out of 100 curated queries, 14 had top-1 flips, mostly short queries with candidate length variance. Avg score delta for flipped items ~0.018. Going to add visual diffs and pairwise breakdown to the report.

Eve R. (Product): postmortem owner: Eve. Include why per-candidate normalization was not classified as a breaking change and update model onboarding checklist.

Lina C. (Customer Success): I'll send the customer note now and attach Ravi's interim diff. Closing this thread once comms out.

deploy-bot: canary c-9274 -> observed metric regression? No - perf OK.

Lina C. (Customer Success): thread note: resolved for BetaMart via targeted pin. We'll follow up with a formal postmortem and product follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
